verdict: Organic traffic is softening; three open milestones need resolution this week.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all activity came through organic channels — no paid ads ran on Meta or Google. Your Google Business Profile delivered 150 actions (calls, directions, and website clicks) over the period, but the last three days of the window recorded a sharp drop, with calls down 46% versus the prior seven days and website sessions falling 39% over the same short stretch. Seven new opportunities entered the pipeline this period, though none have converted to booked appointments, pointing to a gap in the intake process rather than a lead-volume problem — that intake flow is being reviewed and tightened now. Three project milestones — phone-call attribution, contact cleanup, and dashboard completion — are overdue and are being prioritised for closure before the engagement end date of October 31.
